title: Pour, or Weigh?
prompt: One equals sign POURS into a chest. Two equals signs WEIGH two chests. Build the weighing.

fragments.wrong_hint: A single = POURS 40 into gold. It changes the chest. To ASK whether they are equal, you need ==.
> asks which is heavier, not whether they match. For equality, use ==.

config.success: gold == 40 — the balance holds only if both sides weigh exactly the same.
